title: Die Weinwelt schafft sich selber ab
summary: Stephan Reinhardt critiques the German wine industry's self-destructive practices, particularly the manipulation of wines through added sugar and extended maceration to artificially enhance body and intensity, diverging from traditional German white wine characteristics. He argues that the wine world has become detached from reality, relying on marketing narratives rather than genuine quality, while facing economic collapse as wineries and merchants declare bankruptcy and consumers increasingly turn to alternative beverages.
